items.title: Do not carry over CALC_DEBUG tracing into the Rust build

fields.summary: Should the Rust version keep reading CALC_DEBUG from the environment (Q2)?
fields.options: 1. Keep CALC_DEBUG. 2. Replace it with a --debug flag that writes to stderr.
fields.evaluation: An environment variable silently changes stdout (io:env:src/util.cpp:6), so a script's output depends on its caller's environment.
